create.name: Devaa Haley Mitchell
create.bio:
Devaa Haley Mitchell is a spiritual teacher, interfaith minister and sacred musician whose work focuses on the sacred feminine. She studied anthropology and international development at Stanford University, carried out Fulbright-funded research in the Brazilian Amazon, and later earned a Doctorate in Ministry at Wisdom University. Before co-founding The Shift Network, she was the founding executive director of the Full Circle Fund and director of member engagement at the Institute of Noetic Sciences. She is an ordained priestess and a focaliser of the 13 Moon Mystery School, which draws on the Avalonian tradition of the sacred feminine.

Her teaching works with feminine archetypes, the lunar cycle, ritual, meditation and song to help women clarify their calling and lead on their own terms. She founded the Inspiring Women with Soul series, and her online courses include The Divine Feminine Activation, The Feminine Fire Empowerment and Reclaim the 'WildWise' Woman Within. Through her practice, Radiant Essence, she offers coaching, mentoring and retreats, and she has released two albums of devotional world music, Sacred Alchemy and Rebirth.

courses.title: The Divine Feminine Activation
courses.description: A self-paced Shift Network course of seven recorded modules that pairs the phases of the moon with 13 feminine archetypes. Each module includes practices such as creative expression, self-anointing and boundary setting, aimed at clarifying a soul calling.

courses.title: Reclaim the 'WildWise' Woman Within
courses.description: A self-paced Shift Network course in seven modules, each with a recorded teaching and a shorter ritual session. It looks at conditioning, shadow emotions such as anger and shame, and the archetypes of the Queen and the Wise Woman.

courses.title: The Feminine Fire Empowerment
courses.description: An eight-module on-demand Shift Network training that draws on goddess archetypes such as Pele, Kali, Isis and the Great Mother. Practices cover boundaries, speaking one's truth and letting go of limiting beliefs.

courses.title: Soulful Women Audio & Workbook Program
courses.description: Thirteen guided audio meditations, one for each of 13 feminine archetypes, with a 56-page illustrated guidebook. Developed by Devaa Haley Mitchell with Elayne Kalila Doughty and Ariel Spilsbury.

free_resources.title: Dynamic Manifestation Video Series
free_resources.description: A free three-part video series, given on sign-up, that opens with a Roots and Branches centring meditation. The other parts cover visioning your goals and the support needed to bring them about.
